_comment: Canonical Prop Farm recipes — the known-good inputs for each prop so regenerating reproduces the same detail level (prompt drift was the cause of 'why did the mesh change'). prop_pull.py --name <key> loads this when --prompt is omitted. Note: even with identical inputs the GPU pipeline isn't bit-deterministic, but the DETAIL level is governed by the prompt+seed here.

tuning_bench.prompt: a sturdy wooden carpenter's workbench with a dark walnut top and four turned legs, a low back rack holding a row of upright slim silver steel rods, a black iron vise clamped to one end, and brass and chrome hand tools lying flat on the top

table_saw.prompt: a woodworking table saw: a flat cast-iron grey metal table top, a charcoal-black steel frame and four legs, a bright orange motor housing on the side, a silver circular saw blade rising through the table, and a yellow rip-fence rail

organ.prompt: an antique pipe organ console: a dark walnut wood cabinet, a tall bank of golden brass pipes rising above the cabinet, a cream and black keyboard, and polished brass trim accents
